alt: An S3 bucket browser for cocoindex-example-data under the prefix markdown_files/ lists three Markdown objects; on a re-run, objects with the same LastModified are skipped and rfc8259.md, whose ETag changed, is re-embedded with RecursiveSplitter and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into the Postgres table coco_examples.amazon_s3_doc_embeddings, and the query "what is self-attention?" returns a chunk from the Transformer paper.

run.note: Set S3_BUCKET (optional S3_PREFIX) in .env, then install
Scan the bucket and build the index; re-run for changes
